prompt:
GLOBAL CONTINUITY — har scene mein
Photorealistic cinematic sci-fi action, 16:9 landscape, ultra-detailed, realistic materials, dramatic urban lighting, shallow depth of field, dynamic camera movement. Keep the exact same futuristic city, red/black color palette, robotic technology, hooded armored humanoid and orange combat robot consistent across all scenes. Each scene must directly continue from the previous scene with seamless visual continuity. No text, logos, watermark or UI.
SCENE 1 — 0–6s
Close-up of a futuristic metallic cylindrical device lying on a city street, surrounded by hundreds of small glowing green cubes. The device begins transforming from green energy to intense red energy. Slow cinematic push-in, realistic reflections, shallow depth of field.
SCENE 2 — 6–14s
The device becomes a powerful red glowing core with a circular symbol, surrounded by hundreds of red cubes spreading across the empty city street. Low-angle cinematic tracking shot, intense red illumination, realistic atmosphere and debris.
SCENE 3 — 14–24s
The red cubes rapidly multiply and spread across the entire street. Camera rises into a high overhead shot, revealing an enormous field of glowing red cubes surrounding the central device. The cubes begin moving and gathering together.
SCENE 4 — 24–40s
Thousands of red cubes violently assemble into the lower body and legs of a gigantic humanoid creature. The creature rises from the street as cubes continuously lock together, forming detailed black-and-red futuristic armor. Low-angle camera, powerful scale, dust and debris.
SCENE 5 — 40–54s
The enormous humanoid structure continues forming, then collapses and condenses into a smaller hooded armored warrior. Red cubes flow around its body and fuse into sleek black futuristic armor with glowing red energy details. Cinematic transformation close-ups.
SCENE 6 — 54–68s
The hooded armored warrior lands heavily on the city street, surrounded by scattered red cubes. Reveal the full character: black futuristic armor, hood, glowing red mechanical face and red energy core on the chest. Slow dramatic camera reveal.
SCENE 7 — 68–80s
Close-up of the warrior's armored chest and glowing red core. A red cylindrical energy device rises from the ground. The warrior reaches down with a black armored hand and lifts it. Cut between detailed hand, device and glowing chest core.
SCENE 8 — 80–94s
A futuristic orange combat robot appears in the ruined city street facing the hooded warrior. Both stand several meters apart in a tense standoff. The robot has sleek orange armor, dark mechanical joints and a glowing visor. Cinematic alternating close-ups.
SCENE 9 — 94–108s
The orange combat robot suddenly attacks at high speed. The hooded warrior raises its arm and releases a powerful red energy blast. The robot dodges and moves rapidly through smoke and debris. Dynamic tracking camera, intense action, realistic explosions.
SCENE 10 — 108–122s
The hooded warrior unleashes a massive concentrated red energy beam down the city street. The orange robot charges forward and dodges between buildings and explosions. Fast cinematic camera movement, flying debris, smoke, sparks and intense red light.
SCENE 11 — 122–136s
Wide cinematic shot of the devastated city street. The hooded warrior stands in the center as multiple orange combat robots and dark armored figures surround it from both sides. The warrior prepares for another fight while the enemies advance. End on a powerful wide shot.
